notes.title: Backspace Bouken: The Numb Lock is available now!
notes.content:
Backspace Bouken: The Numb Lock is out now as a free post-game update!
We really enjoyed making this short holiday celebration & hope you enjoy playing it. 😊
✔️ New area & enemies ⚔️
✔️ New music 🎵
✔️ New boss fight 🎄
✔️ New achievements ⭐️
In addition, the game is $5 during the Steam Winter Sale!
[previewyoutube=xd_VsclScRw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Join our Discord server!
notes.content:
Hello to all the new players! :)
We have a [url=https://discord.gg/BWW9YNF]discord server[/url] for discussing Backspace Bouken, getting help with the game, speedrun strats, and our upcoming game Poly's Roly Rumble! https://discord.gg/BWW9YNF

We also have a [url=https://www.patreon.com/rngparty]Patreon[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/RNGParty]Twitter[/url] if you're interested in following us there!

Hope you enjoy Backspace Bouken! Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Backspace Bouken OST Announcement
notes.content:
The Backspace Bouken OST will be available on Steam & Bandcamp this Friday when the game comes out! It'll consist of 19 tracks or around 30 minutes of music for $4.99.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197470/Backspace_Bouken__Original_Soundtrack/]Store Link[/url]

notes.title: Backspace Bouken Launches next Friday!
notes.content:
Finally, Backspace Bouken is coming out December 13th on Steam and Itch.

The game will launch for $14.99 and we'll have a 10% discount for the first week.

Enjoy this brand new trailer, and wishlist the game to be notified when it drops!

[previewyoutube=vvQ3-nS1_14;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://twitter.com/BackspaceBouken]Follow us on Twitter[/url] as well!

notes.title: Backspace Bouken is coming (very) soon! (also, achievements)
notes.content:
Backspace Bouken IS still coming out in 2019 (that means this month)! We will have news to share very soon. We're in our playtesting phase and the bulk of the game is complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35166057/de6fc54d6cd44ad5dbe1c9fef2bf347a744571db.jpg[/img]

Also -- we've finished implementing Steam Achievements! There will be 26 in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35166057/135aaf41084765d90571caedcc24565941e414c5.png[/img]

Make sure to [url=https://twitter.com/BackspaceBouken]follow us on Twitter[/url] for updates, [url=http://discord.gg/BWW9YNF]join our Discord[/url], and wishlist the game on Steam!

notes.title: Backspace Bouken Beta Demo Available!
notes.content:
Wrestle a high-speed battle system that relies on your typing skills in Backspace Bouken, the old-school dungeon crawler. We’re proud to release a new beta demo, this time directly on Steam! [url=https://forms.gle/qFcyScVW4Kh7UkKy7]We'd appreciate any feedback you have here![/url]

Please [url=https://twitter.com/BackspaceBouken]follow us on Twitter[/url] and [url=https://backspacebouken.com/]sign up for the mailing list[/url] if you're interested. In addition, we launched an official Discord server a few days ago, so stop by to share your feedback about the beta!

[previewyoutube=r0UexeqRNks;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Some important news and our very own Discord server!
notes.content:
Come join our Discord server! Here we can provide support for the game as well as receive feedback from players and share less-official "devlogs" and bits that we're working on.

https://discord.gg/BWW9YNF

In addition, keep an eye out from some more news from us very soon. We hope to have something new for you to play... Make sure you're [url=https://twitter.com/BackspaceBouken]following us on Twitter[/url] or signed up to [url=https://backspacebouken.com/]the mailing list.[/url]
